about: Release 1.4.3's whole code on all twelve held-out cases, three runs each in five modes (Rules only, Site policy with the board not live and live, the single investigator and the board), under one site profile and the same gate for every mode. A regression rerun on cases that have influenced fixes since 1.0.0, not a new held-out test. Graded by tests/fair_test/grade.py, unchanged. Run records only: no logs, traces or exports.
played_on: the AI Hub 109 instance of results-v111.json and results-r132-f03-f07.json (IRIS for Health Community 2027.1.0AI.109.0 with AI Hub), 11 November 2026: release 1.4.3's src/ (255 documents) loaded and compiled over the 1.3.2 build, its knowledge/ copied into the module root and checked by SHA-256, Shutter.Setup.Install and Hospital.Setup.Install run again over the kept data, and Shutter.Production restarted at 01:25 UTC; the instance then reported version 1.4.3 and gate policy 2026-11-07.1. Played from 01:27 to 03:28 UTC. The sealed manifest checked OK before and after.
site_profile: One profile for every run: the stored profile of results-r132-f03-f07.json (version 75: recovery.mode enabled, further_messages.in_patient_movement show), with each case's own fields put in before its run and taken out after it, as play.py does. No exemption of any kind.
method: tests/fair_test/play.py and grade.py as published, seed 20261106, --day 2026-11-05, 600 s timeout, approval by the rig, E6's case order; every board member and the single investigator on claude-opus-5-5, live. Rules only and Site policy without a live board ran with the agents in replay, where no recording exists for these cases; the other three modes ran live. One play at a time.
